column1: # firmware/partitions.csv: custom flash layout with two app slots for OTA updates
# Why custom: the built-in tables have a single app partition
# nowhere to write a new firmware image while the current one runs. OTA needs
# two app slots plus an "otadata" partition that records which slot to boot.
# How OTA uses it (docs/DESIGN.md §8
#   - The board runs from one slot (say ota_0) and writes the new image into
#     the other (ota_1)
column2: then updates otadata and reboots into it.

column1: #   - If the new image fails to boot or fails its self-test
#     falls back to the previous slot (CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE).
# Layout for 4 MB flash (ESP32-C6FH4). Offsets must be 64 KB (0x10000) aligned
# for app partitions. Sizes: each slot is 1.94 MB; the v1 app is ~1.4 MB.
#   0x000000  bootloader (written by the build
#   0x008000  partition table (not listed here)
#   0x009000  nvs        24 KB  Wi-Fi credentials live here. Keeping the same
#                               offset/size as the old layout means provisioned
#                               devices keep their credentials across this change.
#   0x00F000  otadata     8 KB  Which slot to boot; two copies for safety.
#   0x011000  phy_init    4 KB  Radio calibration data.
#   0x020000  ota_0    1.94 MB  App slot A.
#   0x210000  ota_1    1.94 MB  App slot B.
# Name
nvs
otadata
phy_init
ota_0
ota_1
